product.title: The Rookie Deal
product.summary: Agent a top-five pick from draft night to the extension decision.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students represent a high draft pick through the rookie-scale contract, a shoe-deal choice and a development focus, then face the extension against free agency, with a final performance score naming what the player became.
product.technology: Next.js 16 + React 19 route, with a grade-band toggle

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: The most decision-dense of the bonus simulations. Not deployed, and no student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: No GitHub Pages deployment (404) and no other live URL found. Requires a build to run.
knownBlockers: No deployment — an instructor cannot run it today without building the app.

provenance.evidence: BSC-anythingelse/app/rookie-deal/page.tsx steps through Draft Night, Shoe Deal, Dev Focus, Year 3, Extension and Outcome, grading from a cumulative score.
openQuestions: The grade-band toggle its sibling simulations carry was not directly confirmed in this file.
